desc:
🔥 SEASON 1: SKY SHIELD — new event! 🔥
Team up with other players to protect the city and earn rewards. 🏆 Top defenders get a special prize!

🏭 Build your own drone factory and grow your base
🎯 Practice on the training range next to your base
📡 Set up defense systems and control them yourself
⭐ Season path: levels, camos and titles
🔧 Workshop: upgrades for your drones
🌆 Restore the city and earn bonuses
🎁 Daily rewards for logging in and playing

📱 Play on PC and mobile. Languages: English, русский, українська.
